description: Batch processing: an array of requests produces an array of correlated responses, each keyed to its request id; successful and failing sub-requests coexist in one batch, each carrying its own result or error.

cases.expected_output:
batch_size=2
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=success
result="a"
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="overloaded:int:5"

cases.description: mixed success and error in one batch
cases.expected_output:
batch_size=3
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=success
result="overloaded:string:a"
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=3
outcome=success
result="c"
